about_the_game:
A Bibelot: Tiret sur Will is a precision platformer for all and for speedrunners as well.

Features

  • 4 players Local Co-op, other players can join at any moment

  • 20 levels

  • 3 difficulty modes

    • Easy: All checkpoints are available, fewer spikes in levels, some platforms are added

    • Normal: Some checkpoints are available, all spikes, no platforms added

    • Hard: No checkpoint available, all spikes, no platforms added

  • Speedrun

    • Speedrun Timer: ON by default, will only trigger when you start from Level 1

    • Level Timer: If Speedrun Timer is off, it will show a per level timer instead

    • Speedrun Training Mode: By toggling this, you can train on a level, it will show you your best time of the level, and finishing it will make you restart it instead of going to the next one

short_description: This is your average precision platformer. Playable in 4 player Coop, a choice to have a speedrun timer for well, speedrunners, tons (maybe an exaggeration) of secrets and places to go out of bounds, tons of achievements, tons of CRT scanlines, and maybe, tons of fun?
